opportunities.title: Especialista Seo para Aumentar Reservas Directas en Web de Tours Gu...
opportunities.description: Se busca un especialista SEO freelance con dominio del español para optimizar el posicionamiento web de una empresa de tours privados guiados (en español). El objetivo principal es incrementar las reservas directas y reducir la dependencia de plataformas intermediarias. El proyecto se estructura en tres fases clave: 1. Auditoría SEO Completa: Incluirá un análisis exhaustivo de seo técnico (velocidad de carga, optimización móvil, indexación, errores de rastreo, redirecciones y datos estructurados), seo on-page (títulos, descripciones, encabezados, enlaces internos e imágenes), calidad del contenido, análisis del recorrido del usuario hasta la reserva, evaluación de enlaces entrantes y configuración/revisión de google search console, google analytics 4 y google business profile. 2. Estudio de Competencia Detallado: Se realizará un análisis de entre 5 y 8 competidores directos, así como de las plataformas que compiten por las mismas búsquedas. Se compararán palabras clave, estructura web, contenido, perfil de enlaces y reseñas, con el fin de identificar oportunidades claras con alta intención de compra. 3. Plan de Implementación y Seguimiento: Desarrollo de un plan priorizado para la implementación de cambios técnicos y on-page, creación de una hoja de ruta de contenidos, diseño de una estrategia de SEO local y gestión de reseñas, y configuración de seguimiento de conversiones para medir directamente el aumento de reservas. Entregables esperados: - Informe de auditoría SEO detallado. - Informe de análisis de competencia. - Plan de acción SEO por fases. - Documentación de los cambios implementados. - Informe final con recomendaciones estratégicas para los meses siguientes. Requisitos del perfil: - Español nativo o nivel avanzado demostrable. - Experiencia comprobable en SEO para el sector turístico o plataformas de reservas online. - Dominio de Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 y herramientas profesionales como Semrush, Ahrefs o Screaming Frog. - Capacidad para comunicar y explicar conceptos técnicos de forma clara y concisa. Al postularte, por favor, incluye: - Dos o tres casos de éxito relevantes con resultados medibles. - Tu metodología de trabajo. - Cómo propones medir el éxito del proyecto. - Plazo estimado para cada fase. - Presupuesto - Si ofreces un servicio de seguimiento mensual posterior a la finalización del proyecto. Categoría: Marketing Digital y Ventas Subcategoría: SEO ¿Qué necesitas?: Crear e implementar un plan de SEO

I already have rough references for the overall style; what I’m missing are clean sketches, a detailed tech pack (measurements, stitch lines, fabric call-outs), and any 3D mock-ups that will help a manufacturer quote accurately. Familiarity with Adobe Illustrator or similar vector tools is important because the factory will rely on layered files. If you also use CLO3D, Marvelous Designer, or another garment-simulation platform, feel free to mention it—seeing the jacket drape virtually would speed approvals. Once we agree on direction, I’d like two review rounds for feedback on fit adjustments and branding placement. Deliverables at the end are: • Final flat sketches in AI or EPS • Complete tech pack (PDF) • Optional 3D garment file, if you work in a simulation program Please include examples of previous outerwear projects or any technical packs you’ve created so I can gauge fit with this job. I’m ready to start as soon as I find the right match.

opportunities.description: AI Training Engineer — Fine-Tune Domain Q&A Model frontend/backend for KnowEaseAI What We're Building KnowEaseAI is an AI-powered interview prep platform for data engineers and ML practitioners. We need an ML engineer to fine-tune a domain-specific LLM on our support tickets and learner chat data so it can answer platform and domain questions accurately in real time. Deliverables 1. Cleaned, anonymised, documented training dataset (train/val/test splits) 2. Refundable within 7-10 business days if not awarded project. 2. Complete the Skill Audit here www.knoweaseai.com/audit - share score screenshot 3. Complete any one Learning Modules (LLM, RAG, MLOps, Agentic AI) here www.knoweaseai.com/explore Only freelancers completed above steps will be selected for AI model training team. Weekly working hours and hourly price will be decided on pro subscription taken, skill audit score and succesfull learning module completion. Ideal Candidate - Proven LLM fine-tuning, backend experience - Experience with support automation, RAG, or domain chatbots It's hourly priced job. Minimum 15-20 hr/week required. 8-10 month contract hourly price 1250 - 2500 INR / 12 - 25 USD based on pre-requisite complete and expertise.

opportunities.title: Redacción Técnica Ingeniería Química
opportunities.description: Busco apoyo en Ingeniería química escritorios o secretaria para redactar informes o documentos técnicos. Necesito que tomes la información que yo suministre (datos de proceso, fichas de equipos, parámetros de operación o normativa aplicable) y la transformes en reportes claros, bien estructurados y con lenguaje profesional, listos para presentar a gerencia y autoridades regulatorias. Alcance principal • Redactar y dar formato a los documentos técnicos según mis plantillas o, si lo prefieres, proponer un esquema de secciones lógico y coherente. • Verificar la consistencia de cifras, unidades y referencias bibliográficas. • Incluir tablas, diagramas simples o gráficos de datos cuando sean necesarios para respaldar los argumentos. • Entregar archivos editables (Word o equivalente) y versión PDF final. Valoraré experiencia previa elaborando reportes en ingeniería química, dominio de terminología específica y atención a los detalles de estilo y ortografía. opportunities.title: Sewa WhatsApp Blast Promo
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan layanan sewa akun WhatsApp—lengkap dengan sistem broadcast—untuk mengirimkan penawaran diskon/voucher eksklusif kepada pelanggan lama. Fokusnya adalah mengundang mereka kembali ke promo terbaru kami, jadi pesan harus terpersonalisasi, ramah, dan tidak terlihat massal. Ruang lingkup: • Menyediakan akun atau nomor WhatsApp yang “warm” dan siap kirim massal tanpa mudah terblokir. • Mengimpor daftar kontak pelanggan lama (file CSV/Excel saya siapkan). • Menyiapkan template pesan berisi detail diskon, tautan promo, dan kode voucher individual; saya memberikan kontennya, Anda membantu format agar lolos filter. • Menjadwalkan dan mengeksekusi blast hingga selesai, termasuk follow-up satu kali untuk reminder. • Laporan ringkas: jumlah terkirim, delivered, read, serta nomor yang perlu diperbarui. Kriteria keberhasilan: • Tingkat pengiriman minimal 95 %. • Akun tetap aktif setidaknya sampai kampanye berakhir. • Respons cepat jika WhatsApp meminta verifikasi ulang. Pengalaman dengan WhatsApp Business API, WA Blast tool, atau metode serupa sangat saya hargai. Silakan jelaskan pendekatan Anda, perkiraan durasi, dan contoh kampanye sukses sebelumnya.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40805657, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 250 - 750.

opportunities.title: Simple Hotel Service Chatbot Integration
opportunities.description: My hotel website is already live with all core functions in place; the last piece I need is a lightweight chatbot that sits neatly on every page and answers guest questions about our services and facilities—spa hours, restaurant menus, shuttle times, gym access, you name it. You won’t be starting from scratch on the knowledge base: I’ll supply a concise list of question-and-answer pairs that cover everything we want the bot to say. Your task is to wire that list into a chatbot solution, embed it on the existing site, and make sure it responds instantly and accurately on desktop and mobile. Basic styling must match the site’s current look and feel. I’m open to the platform you prefer (Dialogflow, Microsoft Bot Framework, custom JavaScript, or another lightweight alternative) as long as it is easy for me to update the Q&A list later without touching code. Key expectations • Deploy and integrate the chatbot on the current site • Import my Q&A list as the sole knowledge source • Ensure clear, concise answers about hotel services & facilities • Provide brief instructions so I can add or edit Q&As in future When you apply, focus on the relevant experience you have building or integrating similar Q&A-style bots for hospitality—or other customer-facing sites—so I can gauge fit quickly. A working demo or live link is a plus.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40805645, publicado hace 4 horas (hoy)). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 10 - 30.

opportunities.title: Website for selling used forklifts with latest Tech stack and free database
opportunities.description: # Project Title: Website for Selling Used Forklifts with Custom Admin Panel ## Project Overview I am looking for an experienced developer to build a professional, modern, SEO-friendly website for selling used forklifts and material handling equipment in India. The website should function as an online catalogue where customers can browse available used forklifts, view detailed specifications, check prices, see photos and videos, and contact us through WhatsApp or enquiry forms. The most important requirement is an easy-to-use backend panel that allows us to independently manage our complete inventory without any coding knowledge. ## Key Requirements ### 1. Website Design and Frontend - Professional, modern, and mobile-responsive WordPress website. - Homepage showcasing featured forklifts and recently added inventory. - Dedicated inventory page displaying all available forklifts. - Individual listing pages for each machine. - Clean navigation and user-friendly design. - Product image gallery and video support. - Contact Us, About Us, and other essential pages. ### 2. Custom Forklift Listing and Inventory Management Each forklift should have its own listing with structured fields, rather than being managed as a regular blog post. The admin panel should allow us to: - Add, edit, duplicate, and delete forklift listings. - Upload multiple images and videos for each machine. - Update prices, specifications, descriptions, and locations. - Change availability status to Available, Reserved, or Sold. - Automatically reflect backend changes on the live website. - Hide sold machines from available inventory while retaining their records in the backend. - Mark selected machines as featured listings. - Bulk import and update forklift listings using Excel/CSV files. - Manage inventory without editing code. ### 3. Forklift Specifications Each listing should support the following custom fields: - Brand and model - Manufacturing year - Lifting capacity - Fuel type: Diesel, Electric, LPG, etc. - Operating hours - Mast type and maximum lifting height - Fork dimensions - Battery details, where applicable - Tyre condition - Overall machine condition - Selling price - Location - Warranty details, if applicable - Product images and videos - Detailed description - Stock ID and availability status The fields should be configurable so that additional specifications can be added later. ### 4. Search and Filter Functionality Customers should be able to search and filter available forklifts by: - Brand - Lifting capacity - Fuel type - Manufacturing year - Price range - Location - Machine condition - Availability The inventory page should display results clearly, with sorting options such as price, newest listings, and featured machines. ### 5. WhatsApp and Enquiry Management - WhatsApp enquiry button on every forklift listing. - WhatsApp messages should automatically include the relevant forklift model or listing ID. - Request a Quote form on each listing. - Customer details should include name, phone number, email, and enquiry message. - Enquiries should be stored in the WordPress backend. - Admin email notifications for new enquiries. - Basic lead status management, such as New, Contacted, Negotiation, and Converted. ### 6. SEO and Website Performance - SEO-friendly URLs for individual forklift listings. - Editable SEO titles, meta descriptions, and image alt text. - XML sitemap and Google indexing compatibility. - Schema markup where appropriate. - Optimised images and fast page loading. - Mobile-friendly design. - Compatibility with Google Analytics and Google Search Console. - Security measures, backups, and basic spam protection. ### 7. Deliverables - Fully functional WordPress website. - Custom forklift listing system and backend inventory dashboard. - Bulk CSV/Excel import and update functionality. - Search and advanced filters. - WhatsApp integration and enquiry forms. - Basic SEO configuration. - Website deployment on my domain and hosting. - Admin access and complete ownership of the website. - Source code and relevant configuration details. - Training on adding, updating, and marking forklifts as sold. - Testing and bug fixing before final handover. ## Freelancer Application Requirements Please provide the following with your proposal: 1. Use the latest Tech stack 3. Total development cost and estimated completion time (should not be more than 2-3 days). 5. Confirmation that inventory can be managed entirely through the dashboard. 6. Confirmation that bulk inventory import and updates are supported. 7. Details of post-launch support. The main objective is to build a reliable website that allows us to manage our used forklift inventory independently, generate customer enquiries, and expand the website as our stock grows.

opportunities.title: Dropshipping E-Commerce Website Build
opportunities.description: I need a complete, ready-to-sell dropshipping website focused on two main verticals: fashion (women/mens) and hair and beauty products, plus home & kitchen items. The store must feel polished on both desktop and mobile, with intuitive navigation so shoppers can quickly locate products through a robust search bar and fine-grained filters (size, colour, price, category, etc.). Customer accounts are essential. Shoppers should be able to register or sign in, view their order history, and track shipments in real time from their dashboard. Secure checkout, multiple payment gateways, and automated confirmation emails are also expected. While I haven’t chosen a supplier integration yet, platforms like Shopify are preferred. I am open to strong recommendations for services like AliExpress, CJdropshipping, or any others that sync inventory, automate order forwarding, and update tracking data back to my store. Key requirement: This site must be 100% self-serving without requiring my direct interaction with customers. It should automate all order processing, customer service responses (via FAQs or support automation), and tracking updates to avoid manual customer handling. Deliverables: • Fully responsive shopfront with separate fashion for MEN AND WOMEN, INCLUDING SHOES, HAIR AND BEAUTY PRODUCTS AND ACCESSORIES. • Home/kitchen collections • Advanced product search and filter functionality • Customer account system with order tracking • Seamless dropshipping supplier integration, tested and live • Payment gateway setup and basic on-page SEO • Handover of admin credentials and brief walkthrough Additionally: - Candidates must demonstrate prior experience building fully automated dropshipping websites (please provide samples or references). - Must have clear English communication skills for smooth collaboration. - Freelancers should not contact with proposals outside the stated budget range. If you prefer another tech stack solution beyond Shopify or WooCommerce that aligns with this project and future scaling needs—let me know why it suits.

opportunities.title: Build a Professional Construction Website
opportunities.description: # FREELANCER BRIEF – CONSTRUCTION COMPANY WEBSITE DEVELOPMENT **Project:** Design and Development of a Small Construction Company Website **Reference Website:** https://cpmconstruction.co.za/building-construction-services/ ### 1. Project Overview We are looking for a freelancer to design and develop a simple, modern and professional website for a small construction company. The website should be similar in style and functionality to the reference website provided above, but with our own branding, content and images. The objective is to establish a professional online presence, showcase our construction services and completed projects, and allow potential clients to contact us easily. The website should be clean, visually appealing, easy to navigate and cost-effective to maintain. ### 2. Website Pages and Content We envisage approximately **4–5 simple pages**, as follows: **1. Home Page** - Company introduction and overview. - Large banner featuring construction-related imagery. - Brief summary of our services. - Selected completed projects. - Contact Us / Request a Quote button. **2. About Us** - Company background and introduction. - Our experience and capabilities. - Company mission and values. **3. Our Services** A simple presentation of the company's construction services, including: - General building construction. - Residential construction. - Commercial construction. - Renovations and refurbishments. - Building maintenance and associated works. Each service should have a short description and a relevant image. **4. Our Projects** - Gallery of completed and ongoing projects. - Project photographs with brief descriptions. - Ability to add more projects in future. **5. Contact Us** - Company contact details. - Contact enquiry form. - WhatsApp contact button. - Google Maps location, where applicable. ### 3. Design Requirements - Modern, clean and professional construction industry design. - Similar overall appearance and simplicity to the reference website. - Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile devices. - Consistent company branding, colours and logo. - Good-quality images and clear typography. - Simple navigation and fast loading times. - No unnecessary animations or complicated features. ### 4. Technical Requirements We would prefer the website to be developed using **WordPress or another simple content management system**, allowing us to update text, images and projects ourselves without requiring a developer. The freelancer should provide: - Complete website design and development. - Mobile-friendly layout. - Basic search engine optimisation (SEO). - Contact form functionality. - WhatsApp integration. - SSL/HTTPS configuration. - Basic security and spam protection. - Assistance with website hosting and domain configuration. - Access to the website administration dashboard. We do not require e-commerce, customer accounts, online payments or other complex functionality. ### 5. Content and Images We will provide the company name, logo, contact details, company information and available project photographs. The freelancer should assist with the layout, formatting and presentation of the content, including suitable construction-related stock images where necessary. ### 6. Deliverables The final deliverables should include: 1. Fully functional website published on our domain. 2. Responsive desktop and mobile versions. 3. All agreed pages completed and tested. 4. Website administrator login credentials. 5. Basic instructions on updating content and adding project photographs. 6. Transfer of website files and ownership to us. ### 7. Programme and Budget We would like the website completed within approximately **1–2 weeks**, subject to receiving the necessary content. As this is a small construction company, we are looking for a straightforward and affordable solution rather than an elaborate custom-built website. ### 8. Freelancer Proposal Requirements Please provide the following in your quotation: - Fixed price for the complete website. - Estimated completion period. - Examples of similar websites previously developed. - Proposed platform (WordPress or alternative). - Confirmation of what is included in your price. - Any additional costs for hosting, domain, plugins or ongoing maintenance. - Number of design revisions included. - Confirmation that we will have full ownership and administrator access upon completion. **Important:** We are not looking for a complicated website. The emphasis is on a professional appearance, simplicity, ease of maintenance and reasonable cost. The reference website should serve as a guide to the general design and presentation expected.

The website should be similar in style and functionality to the reference website provided above, but with our own branding, content and images. The objective is to establish a professional online presence, showcase our construction services and completed projects, and allow potential clients to contact us easily. The website should be clean, visually appealing, easy to navigate and cost-effective to maintain. ### 2. Website Pages and Content We envisage approximately **4–5 simple pages**, as follows: **1. Home Page** - Company introduction and overview. - Large banner featuring construction-related imagery. - Brief summary of our services. - Selected completed projects. - Contact Us / Request a Quote button. **2. About Us** - Company background and introduction. - Our experience and capabilities. - Company mission and values. **3. Our Services** A simple presentation of the company's construction services, including: - General building construction. - Residential construction. - Commercial construction. - Renovations and refurbishments. - Building maintenance and associated works. Each service should have a short description and a relevant image. **4. Our Projects** - Gallery of completed and ongoing projects. - Project photographs with brief descriptions. - Ability to add more projects in future. **5. Contact Us** - Company contact details. - Contact enquiry form. - WhatsApp contact button. - Google Maps location, where applicable. ### 3. Design Requirements - Modern, clean and professional construction industry design. - Similar overall appearance and simplicity to the reference website. - Fully responsive for desktop, tablet and mobile devices. - Consistent company branding, colours and logo. - Good-quality images and clear typography. - Simple navigation and fast loading times. - No unnecessary animations or complicated features. ### 4. Technical Requirements We would prefer the website to be developed using **WordPress or another simple content management system**, allowing us to update text, images and projects ourselves without requiring a developer. The freelancer should provide: - Complete website design and development. - Mobile-friendly layout. - Basic search engine optimisation (SEO). - Contact form functionality. - WhatsApp integration. - SSL/HTTPS configuration. - Basic security and spam protection. - Assistance with website hosting and domain configuration. - Access to the website administration dashboard. We do not require e-commerce, customer accounts, online payments or other complex functionality. ### 5. Content and Images We will provide the company name, logo, contact details, company information and available project photographs. The freelancer should assist with the layout, formatting and presentation of the content, including suitable construction-related stock images where necessary. ### 6. Deliverables The final deliverables should include: 1. Fully functional website published on our domain. 2. Responsive desktop and mobile versions. 3. All agreed pages completed and tested. 4. Website administrator login credentials. 5. Basic instructions on updating content and adding project photographs. 6. Transfer of website files and ownership to us. ### 7. Programme and Budget We would like the website completed within approximately **1–2 weeks**, subject to receiving the necessary content. As this is a small construction company, we are looking for a straightforward and affordable solution rather than an elaborate custom-built website. ### 8. Freelancer Proposal Requirements Please provide the following in your quotation: - Fixed price for the complete website. - Estimated completion period. - Examples of similar websites previously developed. - Proposed platform (WordPress or alternative). - Confirmation of what is included in your price. - Any additional costs for hosting, domain, plugins or ongoing maintenance. - Number of design revisions included. - Confirmation that we will have full ownership and administrator access upon completion. **Important:** We are not looking for a complicated website. The emphasis is on a professional appearance, simplicity, ease of maintenance and reasonable cost. The reference website should serve as a guide to the general design and presentation expected."

opportunities.title: Finish MERN Video Downloader Site
opportunities.description: I already have a working MERN-stack codebase for a “YouTube-style” video info & downloader site, but it still feels rough around the edges. The core backend in Node.js/Express is in place and the database is wired up with MongoDB; where I need the most help is fixing and completing the current code, especially the React pages and overall user interface. Here is what I still need done—and why your expertise matters: • React front-end polish – Build or refactor components for the home page, results page, and download panel. – Ensure video URL input is robust, provides instant validation, and gracefully handles errors. – Display the fetched title, channel, duration, and thumbnail in a clean, responsive card layout. • Download workflow – Hook the validated link into the existing Node/Express API so users can download only videos that are legally permitted. – Show real-time progress or at least clear feedback (e.g., “preparing file”, “ready”, “error”). • Responsive & modern UI – Material-UI or Tailwind is fine—just keep the design lightweight and mobile-first. – Smooth transitions and consistent styling across breakpoints. • Bug fixing & deployment – Squash any edge-case crashes, memory leaks, or API hiccups you find. – Walk me through deploying to either Vercel or Render; a Docker option for VPS is also okay. You can freely improve the server code where it makes sense, but the priority is the React side and delivering a feature-complete, polished experience. I’m comfortable reading code, so concise, well-commented commits or pull requests are enough for knowledge transfer. Timeline: I’d like this wrapped up within a month, with incremental pushes so we can test together as we go. If you love clean UI work and know the MERN stack inside out, let’s get this site production-ready.

opportunities.title: HTML to WordPress SEO Conversion
opportunities.description: I need my current static HTML website rebuilt on WordPress with a strong focus on dynamic location pages and fully automated schema markup. All existing city-specific pages, text, and media that are already live on the HTML version will become the source for these dynamic pages, so no fresh copy-writing is required—just intelligent reuse inside WordPress. While dynamic locations and schema are the first priority, I also want my present URLs, meta data, and rankings left intact through proper redirects and on-page SEO migration. The site must open fast on both mobile and desktop; please work with a lightweight theme or custom code rather than heavy page-builder apps. Lead-capture is critical. When a visitor submits the enquiry form, I need the same message delivered instantly to both my email and my WhatsApp number, exactly as it happens on the HTML site today. Deliverables • WordPress setup on my hosting with a clean, light theme that matches the existing look • Dynamic location page system powered by the locations/content already on the HTML site • Site-wide automatic schema (Organisation, LocalBusiness, FAQ, etc.) without manual edits for each page • 301 redirects and meta migration so no rankings or indexed URLs are lost • Form integration that pushes leads to email + WhatsApp in real time • Performance tuning to reach green Core Web Vitals and sub-2-second load on GTmetrix I’ll provide the current site files, hosting credentials, and WhatsApp API details once we agree on timeline and cost. Let me know how many days you’ll need and the fixed price for the full hand-over.

opportunities.title: Urgent WordPress Elementor Compatibility Fix
opportunities.description: My WordPress site broke right after I updated Elementor to its latest version. Pages now render incorrectly and some won’t load at all. I need you to dig into the new version’s conflicts, isolate the exact cause, and get the site running flawlessly again without touching the look, content, or structure I already have. Here’s what has to happen: • Pin-point the mismatch between the new Elementor build, WordPress core, and any other plugins that might be clashing. • Apply the cleanest fix—whether that means rolling back, replacing, or patching—then confirm the editor opens and saves normally. • Re-test every critical page (home, inner pages, forms, checkout) on desktop, tablet, and mobile to be sure the original design and responsiveness are intact. • Leave optimized settings in place so future updates won’t trigger the same issue. I work on a live environment, so setting up a quick staging clone before you start is preferred. Once you’re done, I expect the site to load without errors, the layouts to match my original design pixel-for-pixel, and Google’s PageSpeed/Lighthouse scores to be at least what they were before the break. Please tell me about at least one similar Elementor conflict you’ve resolved, the steps you took, and roughly how long the fix required. Direct links or screenshots of the before/after state will help me choose quickly.

opportunities.description: I have the core idea for a mess-free French press and I’m ready to see it visualised. The first release will target coffee drinkers and the familiar 1-litre (34 oz) household capacity. Here’s the brewing flow I’m chasing: • A low-profile basket rests at the bottom of the glass carafe before any grounds go in. • During brewing and pressing, grounds stay inside that basket. • At the end of the plunge, a magnetic (or otherwise quick-coupling) connection lets the plunger grab the basket. • After pouring, the user lifts plunger + basket together, detaches the basket over the bin, gives it a rinse, and they’re done. What I need from you now is a fully fleshed-out product concept with clear drawings that communicate form, function, and user interaction. I’m imagining a short stack of deliverables: – Hand or digital concept sketches that establish overall shape and ergonomic details – An exploded view showing the carafe, basket, magnetic interface, plunger shaft, and lid assembly – At least one 3D rendering or shaded orthographic view that illustrates materials and surface finishes Please make material suggestions (borosilicate glass, food-grade stainless, heat-resistant polymers, magnets suitable for hot liquid environments, etc.) and flag any manufacturing considerations that might influence wall thicknesses, tolerances, or assembly. I’m happy to answer rapid-fire questions as you draw so the concept moves quickly from rough to refined. If this round goes well, the next phase will dive into prototype-ready CAD and testing, but right now I just need the concept captured crisply on the page.

opportunities.title: Instagram Electronics Dropshipping Store Setup
opportunities.description: I’m ready to launch a dropshipping brand that centres on home-and-lifestyle electronic gadgets promoted through Instagram. The strategy is clear: visitors discover the products in my Instagram shop, tap a product tag or the link in bio, and land on a standalone website where they can browse, save favourites to a wish-list, and complete a secure checkout. Here’s the workflow I need built and handed over: • Instagram storefront – cohesive grid design, product tagging enabled, and a clear bio funnel that drives shoppers off-platform. • E-commerce site (Shopify or WooCommerce—whichever you work fastest with) featuring a clean gadget-focused theme, wish-list/favourites function, Stripe / PayPal checkout, and automated tax/shipping calculations. • Dropshipping automation – supplier connection, real-time stock sync, and order forwarding so the fulfilment side runs hands-free. • Essential integrations – Facebook Commerce Manager for catalogue sync, Google Analytics, and basic email capture for abandoned-cart follow-ups. I’ll supply the logo and a short list of initial SKUs; you handle everything from theme tweaks and plugin selection to connecting the payment gateway and testing the entire purchase flow on mobile. When we’re done, I want to open Instagram, tag a product, and know the customer can move from discovery to paid order in a few taps without me touching inventory. If that end-to-end path works flawlessly, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Clean Modern WordPress Redesign
opportunities.description: The job focuses on giving my current WordPress site a fresh, modern feel while also tightening up performance. Only the homepage and other main pages are in scope; product, service, and blog sections stay as they are for now. Visual direction The aesthetic I’m after is clean and simple—think generous white space, crisp typography, intuitive navigation, and restrained use of colour so content carries the weight. Any new layout must remain fully responsive and accessible. Technical requirements The existing install runs on the latest stable WordPress build with a lightweight theme and a handful of standard plugins (Elementor, Yoast, WPForms). You’re free to keep, swap, or rebuild components as long as the end result: • meets Core Web Vitals targets (LCP <2.5 s, CLS <0.1) • scores 90+ on Google PageSpeed for both mobile and desktop • avoids breaking current permalink structure and SEO settings. Deliverables – Page-by-page mock-ups or prototypes for approval (Figma, Adobe XD, or directly in a staging site) – Developed templates/styles implemented on the live server after sign-off – Performance optimisation: image compression, CSS/JS minification, caching and lazy-loading configured – Handover notes explaining key changes and how to tweak them in the dashboard. Acceptance criteria Redesigned pages render correctly across Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge and major mobile browsers, load within the stated speed targets, and maintain all existing page content and forms. Timeline and milestones are flexible; please outline your approach and an estimated schedule when you respond.

opportunities.title: Digitalisasi Dokumen Jamaah Umroh
opportunities.description: Saya membutuhkan bantuan khusus untuk membuat laporan sekaligus menata dokumen jamaah di biro Travel Umroh & Haji tempat saya bekerja. Fokus pekerjaan • Mengubah foto/scan yang sekarang tersebar di WhatsApp menjadi arsip digital yang rapi dan terstruktur. • Menyusun laporan reguler berbasis data pendaftaran, paspor, dan seluruh dokumen jamaah. Rincian tugas 1. Kumpulkan seluruh gambar dokumen dari grup WhatsApp, beri nama file yang konsisten, lalu simpan di folder Google Drive atau sistem serupa sehingga mudah ditelusuri per nama jamaah & keberangkatan. 2. Buat template laporan di Excel atau Google Sheets yang otomatis menampilkan status kelengkapan paspor, visa, serta berkas pendukung lainnya. 3. Lengkapi laporan dengan kolom filter (mis. tanggal daftar, paket, keberangkatan) agar saya bisa mengekspor rekap kapan saja. 4. Pastikan ada prosedur backup sederhana dan panduan singkat agar staf internal dapat melanjutkan pekerjaan tanpa bergantung pada Anda. Kriteria keberhasilan – Seluruh dokumen terunggah dengan penamaan konsisten dan struktur folder jelas. – Laporan dapat di-update hanya dengan memasukkan data baru ke sheet induk, tanpa formula rumit tambahan. – File dapat diakses bersama—minimal di Google Drive—dengan kontrol izin yang aman. Pengalaman yang saya cari • Terbiasa mengelola data jamaah atau data dokumen serupa. • Mahir Google Drive, Google Sheets, atau Excel. • Detail-oriented dan paham pentingnya kerahasiaan data pribadi. Saya siap menyediakan akses WhatsApp, file contoh, dan informasi yang diperlukan segera setelah proyek dimulai.

opportunities.title: Diseño PCB con Sensor Infrarrojo
opportunities.description: Ingeniero electrónico para diseño de PCB con sensor óptico infrarrojo. Se necesita revisión y finalización de una placa al 80% terminada (21 pads). Buscamos un ingeniero electrónico especializado en diseño de PCB para desarrollar una placa de detección óptica destinada a un dispositivo. Buscamos una solución técnicamente probada, similar en concepto a los sistemas de detección óptica que ya funcionan en el mercado. Requisitos técnicos: - PCB con geometría de herradura (U). - Sensores ópticos infrarrojos enfrentados (emisor y receptor). - Funcionamiento en modo semiautomático y automático. - Comparador y acondicionamiento de señal adecuados. - Diseño compacto y fiable. Estamos abiertos a recomendaciones sobre componentes y arquitectura electrónica si permiten mejorar la precisión y fiabilidad del sistema. El trabajo solicitado incluye el diseño del esquemático electrónico, selección de sensores y componentes, diseño y distribución de la PCB, archivos editables del proyecto, lista de materiales (BOM), archivos Gerber y de fabricación, documentación técnica y recomendaciones para realizar pruebas y validar el funcionamiento. Buscamos un profesional con experiencia demostrable en diseño de PCB, conocimientos de sensores infrarrojos y detección óptica, experiencia con señales rápidas y acondicionamiento analógico, y manejo de EasyEDA, KiCad, Altium u otras herramientas equivalentes. Se valorará especialmente haber desarrollado sistemas de detección de objetos en movimiento a alta velocidad. opportunities.title: GA4, GTM & Search Console Setup - Website Analytics & Service Coverage
opportunities.description: **Goal:** Set up and verify tracking using only Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Google Search Console, and Google Tag Manager (GTM). Also review the existing Google Business Profile service list to check that the website’s services are represented. > **Important distinction:** GA4 and Search Console provide reports. GTM is used to install and test tracking tags; it does not provide visitor analytics reports itself. Google Business Profile is included only for the requested service-list check—not as a source of analytics metrics. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107056?hl=en&utm_source=openai)) ## Phase 1 — Audit existing Google tracking - [ ] Check whether GA4, GTM, and Search Console are already set up and collecting data. - [ ] Confirm the site owner has access to the correct accounts and properties. - [ ] Check for duplicate GA4 tags, duplicate page-view events, or obsolete tracking. - [ ] Record the existing GA4 property, GTM container, Search Console property, and reporting time zone. - [ ] Preserve working tracking; do not replace or remove tags until the audit is complete. **Deliverable:** A short audit summary of the existing setup and any issues to resolve. ## Phase 2 — Configure GA4 through GTM - [ ] If GTM is not installed, add the container site-wide through the website’s global template or CMS integration. - [ ] Configure the GA4 tag through GTM, unless the audit confirms an existing installation is working correctly. - [ ] Avoid duplicate GA4 installations through both GTM and another plugin or site setting. - [ ] Confirm GA4 records page views, page titles, page URLs, and traffic sources. - [ ] Set the GA4 reporting time zone to the correct local time zone. - [ ] Use GTM Preview/Tag Assistant to verify tags fire as expected before publishing. GTM’s preview/debug feature shows which tags fire and what data they pass. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/tagmanager/answer/6107056?hl=en&utm_source=openai)) **Acceptance criteria:** - Page views appear in GA4. - Tags fire once, with no duplicate page views. - The reporting time zone is correct. ## Phase 3 — Track website interactions in GA4 Configure these GA4 events through GTM: - [ ] `generate_lead` — fires only after an enquiry form submits successfully. - [ ] `click_phone` — visitor clicks a phone link. - [ ] `click_email` — visitor clicks an email link. - [ ] `service_cta_click` — visitor clicks a key service-page button or link. - [ ] `form_start` — visitor begins filling out a form. - [ ] `form_error` — form error, if it can be tracked reliably. For the events above: - [ ] Add a `service_category` parameter to relevant service-page actions. - [ ] Add a `page_type` parameter, such as `service`, `contact`, or `article`. - [ ] Add a `cta_label` parameter to CTA clicks. - [ ] Mark successful enquiry submissions as GA4 key events. - [ ] Do not send names, email addresses, phone numbers, form contents, or other personal information to GA4. **Acceptance criteria:** - A successful form submission records one `generate_lead`. - A failed submission does not count as a lead. - Phone, email, and CTA clicks record correctly. - Events are tested on desktop and mobile. ## Phase 4 — Use these six service categories Use the service names shown on the website and assign a consistent value to each: 1. Website Design & Management — `website_design_management` 2. Managed IT Services — `managed_it_services` 3. Cybersecurity Services — `cybersecurity_services` 4. Cloud & Microsoft 365 Services — `cloud_microsoft_365` 5. Apple & Windows Computer Repair — `computer_repair` 6. Home Automation — `home_automation` - [ ] Tag each service page view with the relevant category. - [ ] Tag service-page CTA clicks with the relevant category. - [ ] Attach the category to successful enquiries when the enquiry can be reliably attributed to a service. - [ ] Check that every live service page uses the correct category and naming consistently. **Acceptance criteria:** GA4 can report views, CTA clicks, and successful enquiries by each of the six service categories. ## Phase 5 — Configure GA4 reports Use GA4 reports and Explorations to show: - [ ] Visits and engagement by page and landing page. - [ ] Visits and key events by traffic source. - [ ] Successful enquiries, phone clicks, and email clicks by service category. - [ ] Visitors by device category—mobile, desktop, and tablet—and key actions by device. - [ ] Visitors by country, region/province, and city where data is available. - [ ] Website visits and key events by day of week and hour, using the correct local time zone. - [ ] Engagement by page type and service page. GA4 automatically provides technology information such as device category, browser, and operating system. Its geographic reporting includes country, region, and city; location is derived from IP-related information and should be treated as approximate. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/analytics/answer/12980150?co=GENIE.Platform%3DDesktop&hl=en&utm_source=openai)) **Acceptance criteria:** - Reports distinguish visits from enquiries and other contact actions. - Day/hour reports use the correct local time zone. - Location reports are labelled as approximate. - Recommendations about posting times are based on multiple weeks of data, not a single busy period. ## Phase 6 — Configure Google Search Console reporting - [ ] Verify the correct website property in Search Console. - [ ] Confirm the Performance report is available and collecting data. - [ ] Review Search Console data by: - Search query - Page - Country - Device - Date - [ ] Report clicks, impressions, click-through rate (CTR), and average position. - [ ] Identify queries and pages that relate to the six services. - [ ] Compare date ranges to identify changes in Google Search performance. Search Console’s Performance report provides clicks, impressions, CTR, average position, and dimensions such as query, page, country, device, and date. This is **Google Search performance**, not all website visits or on-site interactions. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/webmasters/answer/10268906?hl=en&utm_source=openai)) **Acceptance criteria:** - The site owner can identify which Google searches and pages generate Search impressions and clicks. - Search Console results are not presented as a count of all website traffic. ## Phase 7 — Check the existing Google Business Profile service list This is a **service coverage check**, not an analytics-reporting task. - [ ] Review the existing Google Business Profile. - [ ] Compare its listed services with the six services shown on the website: - Website Design & Management - Managed IT Services - Cybersecurity Services - Cloud & Microsoft 365 Services - Apple & Windows Computer Repair - Home Automation - [ ] Identify services that are missing, outdated, or unclear on the profile. - [ ] Check that the profile’s business categories reasonably match the services offered. - [ ] Prepare a list of recommended additions or edits for approval before making changes. - [ ] If a service is not available in Google’s suggested list, check whether a suitable custom service can be added. Google Business Profile allows service businesses to select suggested services and, where available, add custom services. ([support.google.com](https://support.google.com/business/answer/9455399?hl=en&utm_.com=&utm_source=openai)) **Acceptance criteria:** The site owner receives a clear list showing which of the six website services are covered on the Google Business Profile and which may need attention. ## Phase 8 — Test and hand over - [ ] Test page views and all configured events using GTM Preview/Tag Assistant and GA4 DebugView or Realtime. - [ ] Test each service page, CTA, phone link, email link, and enquiry form. - [ ] Test successful and failed form submissions. - [ ] Confirm events do not fire twice and no personal information is sent to analytics. - [ ] Provide a handover document listing: - GA4 events and what triggers them - Event parameters and the six service-category values - GTM tags and triggers added or changed - GA4 key events - Reporting time zone - Search Console property checked - Google Business Profile service coverage findings - Any known tracking limitations ## Final completion criteria - [ ] GA4 reports website visits, device, approximate location, traffic timing, page/service interest, traffic sources, and key contact actions. - [ ] Search Console reports Google Search queries and page performance. - [ ] GTM is used to manage and test tracking, with no duplicate tags. - [ ] All six website services are represented consistently in GA4 service-category reporting. - [ ] The existing Google Business Profile has been checked against the six website services. - [ ] The site owner receives the audit results, test results, and handover notes.

opportunities.description: Trabajo día a día con un flujo constante de prospectos que llegan a mi WhatsApp interesados en mis servicios profesionales. Mi meta es simple: transformar más de esas conversaciones en ventas cerradas y aumentar los ingresos del negocio. Necesito a un closer que se adueñe del chat, usando exclusivamente mensajes de texto. Sin audios ni llamadas, la comunicación debe ser escrita, ágil y persuasiva. Valoro una redacción impecable en español, dominio de técnicas de cierre consultivo y la habilidad de leer rápidamente las objeciones del cliente para responder con argumentos claros que impulsen la decisión de compra. Qué espero recibir: • Desarrollo y afinado de guiones de texto basados en la oferta actual. • Gestión diaria del pipeline en WhatsApp: seguimiento, recordatorios y cierres. • Reporte breve al finalizar la jornada con número de conversaciones atendidas, cierres logrados y oportunidades pendientes. Considero el trabajo exitoso cuando se nota un incremento tangible en la tasa de conversión y el volumen de ventas por este canal. Si ya tienes experiencia cerrando servicios vía chat y puedes empezar de inmediato, hablemos.

opportunities.description: The activity involves visiting two companies assigned by us in person to request information and obtain two price quotes. To successfully complete the activity, the following is required: 1. Study the guide we provide, understand what needs to be mentioned and what needs to be quoted, and communicate with us via this platform before starting the activity to clarify the objective and resolve any questions. (Estimated time: 1 hour—30 minutes for studying the guide and 30 minutes for Q&A). 2. Visit the assigned companies and branches to receive an in-person explanation of the service and confirm the quote. (Estimated time: 30 minutes plus travel time to each branch; 2–3 hours total). 5. Email us the received quote and an evaluation form. (Estimated time: 30–60 minutes per branch; 1–2 hours total). A total of 4 to 6 hours is required to complete the activity; the payment is a fixed $100 USD upon satisfactory completion. Freelancer Requirements: A. Reside in Cancún and speak fluent Spanish; communication with both us and the companies' sales staff will be in Spanish. B. Have a means of transportation (car or motorcycle). C. Minimum age of 25. D. Have an Android or iOS smartphone with the Freelancer app installed and notifications enabled. (A common reason for project failure is freelancers not monitoring messages or missing notifications, leading to delayed communication; therefore, we ask that you install the app and stay attentive to it for everyone's benefit). If you are interested in this activity and have not performed it previously, please place a bid for the fixed amount of $100 USD and include the municipality where you live in your message to confirm you are not a bot. opportunities.description: La actividad consiste en pedir información y solicitar una cotización de manera presencial en una empresa asignada por nosotros. Para realizar satisfactoriamente la actividad se requiere de lo siguiente: 1. Estudiar guía proporcionada por nosotros, comprender lo que se requiere mencionar y lo que se requiere cotizar, tener comunicación con nosotros por este medio antes de iniciar la actividad para aclarar el objetivo y resolver cualquier duda. (Tiempo aproximado 1 hora, de la cual son 30 minutos de estudio de guía y 30 minutos para resolver dudas). 2. Presentarse en la empresa y sucursal asignada para recibir explicación personal del servicio y confirmación de cotización. (Tiempo aproximado 30 minutos + el traslado) 5. Enviarnos la cotización recibida por correo electrónico y un formulario de evaluación (Tiempo aproximado 30-60 minutos). En total se requieren de 3 a 4 horas para completar la actividad, el pago es fijo y es de $50 USD una vez que la actividad fue completada satisfactoriamente. Requerimientos del Freelancer: A. Vivir en la ciudad de Querétaro. B. Contar con medio de transporte (auto o motocicleta). C. Edad mínima 25 años. D. Contar con un smartphone con Android y/o iOS y tener la app de Freelancer instalada en su teléfono móvil con las notificaciones activadas. (Una de las principales causas de que los proyectos no se logren satisfactoriamente es debido a que los Freelancers no están al pendiente de sus mensajes o no reciben las notificaciones causando una comunicación tardía, por este motivo te pedimos instalar la app y estar al tanto de la misma para beneficio de todos). Si te interesa participar en esta actividad y no has hecho la misma anteriormente realiza tu bid por la cantidad fija $50 USD y escribiendo en el mensaje el municipio en el que vives para confirmar que no eres un bot. Bids por cantidades mayores a $50 USD no serán considerados. Se contratarán varios shoppers para esta actividad. Gracias.

opportunities.title: Smart Website Chat Assistant
opportunities.description: I need a live-chat assistant embedded directly on my website that can stay online around the clock, greet visitors, answer their usual questions, and guide them toward the right product or service so they feel confident enough to click “buy.” To give the assistant solid material to work with, you’ll train it on: • every relevant page already published on the site • a spreadsheet I’ll share that lists products, prices, and key specs • an additional Q&A document that I’ll write for edge-case inquiries The finished chat widget must: • sit neatly on every page without slowing load time • understand and respond in natural, friendly language • recognise when a conversation turns into a sales lead and push calls-to-action (e.g., add to cart, schedule a demo, etc.) I’m platform-agnostic—as long as the solution is reliable, GDPR-compliant, and easy for me to update later, I’m happy. Popular stacks such as Dialogflow, ChatGPT API, Zendesk, or Tidio are welcome if they fit the brief. Deliverables 1. Fully configured chat assistant embedded on my site 2. Imported knowledge base from the three sources above 3. Short hand-over guide showing how I can edit answers or add new ones Once the bot is live and I can test typical queries about pricing, features, and recommended products, we’re done.

opportunities.title: Creación de Contenido Interactivo sobre Teoría del Color para Prees...
opportunities.description: Se busca un profesional para desarrollar contenido educativo interactivo y atractivo, específicamente diseñado para niños en edad preescolar. El objetivo principal es enseñar la teoría del color de una manera divertida y comprensible para este grupo de edad. El proyecto requiere la creación de materiales que fomenten la participación activa de los niños, utilizando elementos visuales vibrantes y mecánicas de interacción sencillas. El formato del contenido puede incluir, pero no limitarse a, juegos interactivos, historias animadas con puntos de decisión, actividades digitales de arrastrar y soltar, o libros interactivos. Se valorará la creatividad en el diseño pedagógico y la capacidad de transformar conceptos complejos en experiencias accesibles y entretenidas para los más pequeños. El entregable final debe ser un conjunto de recursos digitales listos para ser implementados en plataformas educativas o sitios web. opportunities.title: Detailed Low-Poly Elephant Model
opportunities.description: I need a skilled 3D artist to craft a low-poly elephant that looks highly detailed yet still unmistakably faceted. The piece will serve as a production-ready 3D model, suitable both for animation and for physical printing, so clean topology and watertight geometry are essential. Please sculpt and optimise the mesh so the distinctive planes read clearly from every angle while preserving realistic proportions and key anatomical features—trunk curl, tusk shape, ear thickness, leg stance, etc. UVs should be laid out logically, and I’d like a simple flat-colour material applied so I can preview shading before I take it further. Deliverables • Final model in OBJ and FBX (additional STL for print readiness) • Quad-dominant topology, no obvious non-manifold edges or n-gons • UV-mapped and grouped cleanly for easy material assignment • Poly count high enough to capture subtle planes yet efficient for animation (you choose the sweet spot) I will test the file in Blender and Cura; if it imports without errors and passes a quick print preview, the job is done. Let me know your typical turnaround time and any past examples that show you can balance detail with the low-poly aesthetic.

opportunities.title: Luxury Personalized Gift Artisans Needed
opportunities.description: Title: Looking for professional artists to recreate luxury personalized gifts from reference images Hello! I’m looking for talented artists, sculptors, 3D designers and custom gift makers who can turn my reference images into real, physical products. I have several detailed, AI-generated concepts, including: * A luxury personalized teddy bear * A miniature character keychain * A custom snow globe with figurines * A warm LED acrylic lamp * Other personalized collectible gifts The designs feature a girl named Aleyna, her long dark brown hair, elegant cream-white outfit, gold accessories, and a small white budgie. Quality is extremely important to me. I’m not looking for generic printed gifts. I want the finished products to match the reference images as closely as physically possible, including their proportions, colors, facial details, materials and luxurious finish. I’m happy to consider different production methods, including handmade sculpting, resin casting, 3D printing, custom plush-making and acrylic engraving. Please contact me with: * Examples of similar work you’ve completed * Which products you can make * An estimated price * Production time * Shipping options to the Netherlands I would prefer to see a digital preview or prototype before final production. I’m looking for high-quality craftsmanship and am open to discussing the budget depending on the results. Thank you!

opportunities.title: Finalizar App de Auditorías
opportunities.description: Estoy desarrollando una aplicación de auditorías en Microsoft Power Apps con listas de SharePoint ya creadas y necesito ayuda remota para terminarla. Mi prioridad inmediata es el diseño de pantallas y la navegación: quiero pantallas claras donde el usuario pueda crear y completar una nueva auditoría, avanzando por una lista de preguntas con opciones de respuesta predeterminadas. Además, requiero: • Configurar el registro automático de fecha y hora en cada auditoría. • Ajustar la lógica de guardado y validación de datos en SharePoint. • Dejar preparada la conexión para que los resultados se visualicen más adelante en Power BI. En tu propuesta indícame: • Experiencia concreta con Power Apps y SharePoint (menciona ejemplos similares). • Disponibilidad horaria para sesiones remotas. • Tarifa por hora y estimación aproximada para finalizar el proyecto. Busco a alguien que conozca bien colecciones, formularios, galerías, Power Automate y que pueda explicarme brevemente las decisiones de diseño para que el mantenimiento futuro sea sencillo. Si tienes dashboards en Power BI conectados a Power Apps, comparte enlaces o capturas. Espero tu mensaje y ejemplos para empezar cuanto antes.

opportunities.title: Editor de video
opportunities.description: Estoy lanzando una agencia de contenidos en la que yo me encargaré de atraer y gestionar a los clientes; tu misión será transformar su material bruto en piezas impactantes. Qué necesito de ti • Dominio comprobable en Shorts, Reels y demás videos verticales para redes sociales. • Experiencia sólida en podcasts y videos horizontales para YouTube. • Habilidad para editar gameplays, crear animaciones y agregar efectos visuales. Estilo deseado Mis clientes buscan un acabado creativo y llamativo, con animaciones, efectos y diseño personalizado que capte la atención de inmediato. opportunities.title: Accelerate Online Store Speed
opportunities.description: My online store feels sluggish from the moment a visitor lands, and I want every page to snap open instantly. The primary goal is simple: make the entire site load faster so shoppers stay engaged and move smoothly from browsing to checkout. Here’s what I need: • A quick but thorough performance audit using Lighthouse, GTmetrix, or similar tools to identify render-blocking scripts, oversized images, and any bottlenecks in the theme or plugins. • Hands-on optimisation—minifying CSS/JS, compressing images, enabling browser and server-side caching, refining database queries, and configuring a CDN if it will help. • Concrete before-and-after metrics: I’m aiming for a Largest Contentful Paint under 2 seconds and Google PageSpeed scores in the green for both mobile and desktop. Please be comfortable working on live e-commerce sites where downtime must be kept to an absolute minimum. Share a brief outline of your approach and examples of stores you have already sped up, and we can get started right away. removing all the not required processes, old WP installations, updating plugins, removing or disabling unnecessary plugins, etc. Could be the speed problem

opportunities.title: Gestión Integral Redes y Anuncios
opportunities.description: Mi objetivo es conseguir más clientes potenciales o ventas para mi tienda online de productos físicos. Para lograrlo, el trabajo se centra en tres frentes complementarios: • Gestión de redes sociales y creación de publicaciones: calendario mensual, copies atractivos, diseño de piezas estáticas y reels que mantengan coherencia visual con la marca y fomenten la interacción. • Campañas de anuncios en Meta y optimización del píxel: configuración en Ads Manager, segmentación basada en audiencias look-alike e intereses, pruebas A/B, mantenimiento del Meta Pixel y reportes de rendimiento semanales. • Mejoras en la página web para convertir más visitas en clientes: revisión de la estructura, recomendación de ajustes de UX, optimización de velocidad, instalación de pop-ups o formularios que capturen leads e integración con el píxel para un seguimiento preciso. Entregaré acceso a Business Suite, la cuenta publicitaria y el CMS de la web; espero un plan de acción inicial, indicadores clave (ROAS, CPL, tasa de conversión) y ajustes continuos a partir de los datos. La comunicación será directa y clara para iterar rápidamente sobre lo que funcione.

opportunities.title: Bot WhatsApp Respuestas Automáticas
opportunities.description: Quiero poner en marcha un asistente que conteste de forma automática las preguntas frecuentes que recibo por WhatsApp. Alcance del trabajo • Configurar un número nuevo de WhatsApp Business – no usaré el que ya tengo. • Crear el bot para que responda únicamente a partir de la lista de preguntas y respuestas que proporcionaré. opportunities.title: Urgent ETABS Analysis for Water Tank
opportunities.description: I have a nearly-finished 2D AutoCAD drawing (about 98 % complete, grids included) for a small 1 800 mm × 1 800 mm water tank with a 1 100 mm wall height. I now need you to take that file, build a quick ETABS model, and deliver a concise report that lists both the base reactions and the joint displacements. Timing is critical: I must have the model and the report back within the next 3–4 hours. If you find any minor tweaks are required while modelling, just flag them so I can adjust the CAD and return it immediately—we can keep the feedback loop tight. Please use ETABS (any recent version you are comfortable with). The final hand-off should include: • the ETABS .edb file, ready for my records • a PDF (or Excel) summary showing the requested base reactions and joint displacement values for the governing load cases That’s all. Once I receive those two items on time, the job is complete.

opportunities.title: Mantenimiento Data Lake Azure + Pipelines Etl en Databricks
opportunities.description: Tenemos un DataLake montado en Azure con tres capas de explotación de datos Oro/Plata/Bronce. Dentro de la infraestructura tenemos una serie de Pipelines (ETL's) complejos que nos permiten generar una serie de informes. Buscamos un perfil que sea capaz de resolvernos varias incidencias que se han acumulado desde que montamos el DL con una empresa externa, que nos pueda hacer mantenimiento de la infraestructura, así como modificar los flujos y pipelines montados para afinar los informes diseñados. El perfil tendrá como funciones: - Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos. - Optimizar el rendimiento de bases de datos analíticas. - Diseñar modelos de datos y estructuras de Data Lake. - Garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de la información. - Dar soporte en analítica y reporting (en la transformaciones de las capas Gold/Silver). - Colaborar en la definición de KPIs y explotación de datos para negocio. Como requisitos ha de tener conocimientos de: - Diseño y desarrollo de procesos etl/elt. - SQL avanzado. - PostgreSQL y optimización de consultas, índices, particiones y almacenamiento. - Modelado de datos para entornos analíticos. - Data Lakes con arquitecturas Bronze / Silver / Gold. - Orquestación de procesos con Airflow o herramientas similares. - Python para procesamiento y transformación de datos. - Experiencia con Azure y Databricks. El perfil tiene que poder reunirse en horario de España, aunque trabaje de forma asíncrona mayormente. Imprescindible un perfil de habla hispana. Buscamos un perfil que sea capaz de resolvernos varias incidencias que se han acumulado desde que montamos el DL con una empresa externa, que nos pueda hacer mantenimiento de la infraestructura, así como modificar los flujos y pipelines montados para afinar los informes diseñados. El perfil tendrá como funciones: - Diseñar y mantener pipelines de datos. - Optimizar el rendimiento de bases de datos analíticas. - Diseñar modelos de datos y estructuras de Data Lake. - Garantizar la calidad y trazabilidad de la información. - Dar soporte en analítica y reporting (en la transformaciones de las capas Gold/Silver). - Colaborar en la definición de KPIs y explotación de datos para negocio. Como requisitos ha de tener conocimientos de: - Diseño y desarrollo de procesos etl/elt. - SQL avanzado. - PostgreSQL y optimización de consultas, índices, particiones y almacenamiento. - Modelado de datos para entornos analíticos. - Data Lakes con arquitecturas Bronze / Silver / Gold. - Orquestación de procesos con Airflow o herramientas similares. - Python para procesamiento y transformación de datos. - Experiencia con Azure y Databricks. El perfil tiene que poder reunirse en horario de España, aunque trabaje de forma asíncrona mayormente. Imprescindible un perfil de habla hispana. opportunities.title: Diseño de etiquetas elegantes
opportunities.description: Busco un ilustrador con buen dominio de tipografía y composición para crear la línea completa de etiquetas para perfumes similares a las que aparecen en el estilo mostrado en Stickerr.com. El estilo debe ser claramente elegante y minimalista, sin ornamentos innecesarios, para resaltar la calidad premium de la marca. Alcance • Diseñar un layout maestro coherente con nuestra identidad visual. • Adaptar ese layout a más de cinco fragancias diferentes, manteniendo unidad gráfica pero con pequeñas variaciones de color o motivo que faciliten la distinción de cada aroma. • Incluir únicamente el nombre del perfume y el logotipo en cada versión; otros datos (ingredientes, código de barras) irán en el estuche, por lo que no se incorporan en esta fase. Entregables 1. Archivo vectorial editable (AI o SVG) del diseño maestro. 2. Versiones finales para cada fragancia en PDF listo para imprenta y PNG de alta resolución para redes. 3. Hoja de especificaciones de color y tipografía. Criterios de aceptación – Estética minimalista y coherente en toda la serie. – Legibilidad perfecta del nombre y del logo a escala de 50 mm. – Uso de colores Pantone o CMYK especificados. Aprecio portafolios que muestren trabajos similares al diseño minimalista y sofisticado expuesto en Stickerr.com.
opportunities.contractor_info: Demandante verificado en Freelancer.co (Anuncio #40793878, publicado hace 1 día). Presupuesto ofrecido: USD 30 - 250.
